description: This file defines interfaces related to stream namespace predicate filtering within the Orleans.BroadcastChannel namespace, used for implicit subscription filtering and predicate provisioning.

classes.name: IChannelNamespacePredicate
classes.description: Interface for predicates that determine if a grain should subscribe to a specific stream namespace.

classes.name: IChannelNamespacePredicateProvider
classes.description: Interface for converting predicate pattern strings into predicate instances.

methods.name: IsMatch
methods.description: Determines if the given stream namespace matches the predicate criteria.

methods.name: PredicatePattern
methods.description: Property that returns a pattern string describing this predicate.

methods.name: TryGetPredicate
methods.description: Attempts to create a predicate instance based on a pattern string; returns success status.
